dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible section displays a gradual, symmetric geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth with no discernible bulges or indentations visible at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with high median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, thin vertical linear mark of low contrast is visible in the lower-central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a faint, vertical linear scratch or rake mark on the lower dorsal surface.
